what: The video in the small window at the center of the Hero (.29 wide · .275 tall, 7px up) stays attached to the screen and grows straight to fill it during the first 50% of the section’s travel length (section height − screen). Over 75% of that same length, a black overlay above deepens from 0 → translucent, over 30% the Hero text (logo · menu) disappears, and the upper piece of the vertical copy descends from −17.7vh into place between 1.4% → 60%, gathering toward the window. When the in-between panel head crosses the 25% line from the screen bottom, the copy turns white (.6s), when it crosses the 50% line the intro text floats up (.6s), and after passing the in-between panel both turn off — a Hero where the window becomes the screen

options.from: Initial window scale ”width,height”, default 0.29,0.275 (from-narrow: below 990px — original phone 0.204,0.204)
options.x · x-end: Window start·end horizontal shift (px), default 0·0 (original phone end -60)
options.grow: Range where the window grows (progress ratio ”start,end”), default 0,0.5
options.shade: Range where the overlay darkens, default 0,0.75
options.fade: Range where the Hero text disappears, default 0,0.3
options.piece · piece-from: Range where the upper copy piece descends and its starting position (vh), default 0.0138,0.5958 · -17.7084
options.flip · intro: Bottom margin for watching the sections in between (IntersectionObserver rootMargin), default -25% · -50%
options.dur · ease: Text flip and intro text length (s) and curve, default .6 · 0.61,1,0.88,1
options.[data-fx-part=layer]: Layer covering the whole section (holds window, curtain, copy)
options.[data-fx-part=copy] · [data-fx-part=piec: Vertical copy panel and fragments (optional) — the panel gets is-flip
options.[data-fx-part=intro]: Rising intro text panel (optional) — is-in is added
options.[data-fx-part=fv]: Hero text panel (logo, menu, fixed to the screen)
options.[data-fx-part=spacer]: Spacer panel one screen tall after the Hero — the reference for measuring the threshold

note: The original uses a CSS scroll timeline (animation-timeline: view(), contain 0~100%). Measured the view() ranges of the attached video at 1440×900 (window 0→592.5px · curtain 0→888.75px · hero text 0→355.5px · copy 16→706px, section height 2085 − screen 900 = 1185) moved by progress ratio. Window scaling uses GSAP scaleX/scaleY instead of the scale property. The similar pin-grow-photo has the window rising under a pinned title, sticking, then growing, but this hero has the window in place from the start and the copy flips at a threshold, so it is kept separate.
